title: My Brother-in-Law Stole My $98K Pension, Forged a Dissolution, Sent Me $3.9K. So I Voided His Sale.
description: I emptied my nursing pension to co-found a medical alert pendant company with my brother-in-law, only for him to forge a dissolution, sell the assets, and send me a $3,900 check. I found the original contract hidden in a prototype pendant, voided the sale, and now he assembles wristbands in a smock that says 'Fall Detection of Lies' while every box ships with his fraud docket number. #RevengeStory #FamilyBetrayal #TrueStory
thumb_text: NOW HE WEARS A FALL DETECTION OF LIES SMOCK
pinned_comment: If your brother-in-law forged a dissolution to steal your $98,000 nursing pension and sold your company, what would you have done, and would you have made him wear a 'Fall Detection of Lies' smock like I did? Share your story in the comments.
